rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for offering a price or bidding in an auction.

example.english: I bid three thousand dollars at this auction.
example.traditional: 今次拍賣會我出價三千蚊。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 paak3 maai6 wui2 ngo5 ceot1 gaa3 saam1 cin1 man1

rows.note: Use this when an auction participant is calling out a bid, rather than simply stating an offered price.

example.english: I bid fifty thousand for this item.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 fo3 ngo5 giu3 gaa3 ng5 maan6

rows.note: Use this for submitting a formal tender or bid, especially in a procurement context rather than an auction.

example.english: We will bid for this project next week.
example.traditional: 我哋下星期會投標呢項工程。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 wui5 tau4 biu1 ni1 hong6 gung1 cing4
